title: Detailed component exploration and translations verified
summary: Expanded Phone Lab from 14 to 29 learning topics, with direct image-region selection, a nearby explanation panel and magnification.

changes.detail: 15 English/French/Arabic lessons covering boards, flex cables, connectors, shields, screws, frame, seals, thermal spreading, capacitors, resistors, inductors, power management, flash LED, haptics and microphone.

24 selectable component families across the generated image, including repeated camera/cable/screw regions. Smaller regions take precedence; selected area is outlined. Existing nine large markers retained.
Nearby role and everyday-example inspector, accessible component picker, 2x magnification and explicit full-lesson link. Existing saved topic IDs remain valid; progress includes new topics.
Restored corrupted French accents and Arabic captions/view labels and translated the AI-generated-image explanation.

validation.name: Phone interaction and history tests
validation.detail: 10 tests passed. Each of 24 image component families was selected at 300px and 600px image widths, including a panned offset, in English/French/Arabic. Role, example, selected outline, accessible picker, magnification, marker taps, double taps, mode switching, image fallback, quiz and progress checked. Four phone tests passed again after adding blank-background and scroll-cancellation assertions.

validation.name: Content and translations
validation.detail: 29 topics contain names, roles and everyday examples in all three languages. Tests reject question-mark corruption and explicitly check French accents and Arabic caption text. Old and new learning IDs remain valid. Capacitor/inductor fundamentals checked against Murata references retained in phone-detail-topics.ts.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: App typecheck passed. Focused lint passed with --no-ignore to include the normally excluded data files as well as both document/view modules.

validation.name: History retention
validation.detail: 193 preceding reports passed history integrity check before this follow-up.

validation.name: Live browser/native validation
validation.detail: Browser tool returned no available browsers. Live layout, magnification scrolling and physical touch gestures remain unverified. No deployment or APK rebuild. Regions illustrate component families in an AI-generated image; they cannot identify every real chip or provide an exact repair map.
